archetypes.name: dyn-reentry-state
archetypes.rationale: The fix hinges on exactly which state Step 3 re-entry clears versus preserves.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed Step 3 re-entry cleanup and regression tests. Confirm the bgjob result envs are removed only through the shared downstream cleanup path and that direct no-op re-entry still preserves seeded stale files. Check that no unrelated bgjob registry, merge env, or live process state is removed. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
